reasons.action: The request only specifies that the subject draws its body from the first picture and its wheels from the second; it asks for no new behavior, performance, or movement. Action therefore remains governed by the references.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the observed live-action rendering. No requested style phrase, rendering process, or target medium is supplied, so rendering medium stays reference-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested. The wheel-source instruction is a subject-identity attribute already resolved by identity_requirements, not a wardrobe override, so wardrobe remains governed by the references.
reasons.lighting: The request contains no instruction about light, an illuminating source, its direction, or visible quality. Lighting therefore remains governed by the references.
reasons.framing: The request mentions no camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint, or camera movement. Choosing an aspect ratio and combining subject parts do not constitute framing instructions, so framing remains governed by the references.
reasons.palette: The request specifies no color grade, saturation, contrast, or tonal treatment. It only combines body and wheel sources, so palette remains governed by the references.
